item.title: Electronic Health Record Implementation: Key Steps, Costs, and Best Practices
item.summary: Adding software to a clinic is not like updating a phone app. A proper electronic health record implementation represents a deep operational, clinical, and technical overhaul that reshapes daily care delivery. It alters how doctors write notes, how nurses record vitals, and how billers process claims. (It is rarely easy.)
